physical.text: This handwriting robot was designed to identify the
words and writer of any piece of handwritten text,
then reproduce new sentences in that same person's
style using a gantry and pen. Over 13 different
writers were used to train and test the system, each
contributing several pages so the network could
learn how they loop their letters, slant their lines
and space their words.
